description: This Java class 'TypeQualifiers' manages type qualifier information for primitive data types in Hive, such as character length, precision, and scale. It includes methods for converting to and from Thrift representations and for deriving qualifiers from type info objects.

classes.name: TypeQualifiers
classes.description: A class representing type qualifier information such as character length, precision, and scale for primitive types in Hive.

methods.name: getCharacterMaximumLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum character length for types like CHAR or VARCHAR.

methods.name: setCharacterMaximumLength
methods.description: Sets the maximum character length for the type.

methods.name: toTTypeQualifiers
methods.description: Converts the TypeQualifiers instance to its Thrift representation.

methods.name: fromTTypeQualifiers
methods.description: Creates a TypeQualifiers instance from its Thrift representation.

methods.name: fromTypeInfo
methods.description: Creates a TypeQualifiers instance from a PrimitiveTypeInfo object.

methods.name: getPrecision
methods.description: Returns the precision value for decimal types.

methods.name: setPrecision
methods.description: Sets the precision value for decimal types.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the scale value for decimal types.

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Sets the scale value for decimal types.
